reversals: Improvement
Development
Treat betterment as one trajectory of formation or elaboration. This excludes improvements by deletion, simplification, or removal unless development is broadened.
Define development as advancement under a stated standard. This admits only improving development, not every elaboration.
Change, if the developing process and its before/after change are compared consistently.
One hierarchy privileges growth of structure; the reverse privileges comparative benefit. They would fund different work.
A harmful elaboration and a beneficial deletion separate the two accounts without changing the standard mid-test.
Intelligence
Improvement
Define intelligent activity as improving the adequacy of available means to a situation. This classifies activity or transitions, not a retained capability.
Restrict improvement to adaptive betterment achieved through selecting or constructing means. Accidental or fixed mechanical improvements are then excluded.
Capability to improve; or adaptive regulation as a new proposed class. Neither contains every improvement automatically.
Intelligence would be examined through how work becomes better, while improvement would acquire selection and adaptation requirements.
Compare retained capability at rest, intelligent preservation of an already good state, accidental improvement, and a fixed successful repair.
Intelligence
Creation
Classify manifestations of intelligence as creation of useful distinctions, representations, or possible actions. Name the created item and identity baseline.
Treat creation as intelligent generation only when adaptive selection or construction is required. Unintelligent or natural generation no longer qualifies.
Capability to construct; alternatively processes altering the available possibilities after changing both senses to activities.
This exposes generative contributions hidden by an inference-only account of intelligence, but can erase competent reuse.
An agent selects an existing adequate solution without generating a new candidate; a fixed generator produces new unusable arrangements.
Development
Intelligence
Restrict development to the growth or organization of adaptive capability. Development of unrelated structures remains outside.
Treat intelligence as a developmental process rather than a retained ability. Its acquisition, current exercise, and possession must then be distinguished.
Formation and use of capability, a proposed programme rather than a proved exclusive type.
The time horizon changes from present performance to the production and organization of ability.
An already capable resting agent and an elaborating nonadaptive mechanism distinguish ability from its development.
Development
Creation
View development as continuing creation of organization, capacity, or structure. The target must actually become new under a stated identity.
View creation as the initial phase of development. This assumes a developing trajectory beyond the introduction event.
Transformation and Process in the admitted primary model.
The first direction makes novelty continuous; the reverse treats beginnings as one phase of a longer formation.
A one-time new arrangement that is immediately discarded tests whether creation entails further development.
Improvement
Creation
Treat betterment as creation of a better successor. The change becomes a constructive process or successor artifact.
Require newly created things to be better than their comparison baseline. Novel but worse products are then excluded.
Change in the primary model; creation of better alternatives in a narrower combined scope.
It becomes impossible to count mere novelty as success, but useful subtraction must remain representable.
Removing a defect improves a result; constructing a new defect creates a novelty. Keep the same quality criterion.
Learning
Improvement
Define learning normatively as beneficial experiential update. This excludes maladaptive acquisition rather than showing it never occurs.
Define improvement as betterment learned from results. Fixed repairs, chance changes, and improvements without an updating agent are excluded.
Change; beneficial experience-dependent change is their intersection.
This separates a science of how behavior changes from a science of which changes are better.
A persistent worsening induced by feedback and a beneficial repair without learning defeat the unrestricted directions.
Learning
Intelligence
Treat learning as an adaptive capability, changing the subject from an update to the ability to update.
Define intelligence as effective adaptation through experience. Fixed transferable skill and one-shot construction require explicit treatment.
Capability under capacity readings; Change under update readings. There is no free move between them.
The question shifts between having an ability, exercising it, and changing it.
Hold current task performance fixed while changing whether the agent's policy updates from results.
Reasoning
Intelligence
Classify reasoning capability as a species of adaptive intellectual capability, not every particular reasoning episode as a capability.
Define intelligent activity as transitions through intellectual representations. Embodied or habitual adaptation may be excluded by this definition.
Capability when both name powers; Process when both name activities.
The first direction specializes an ability; the reverse attempts a theory of all intelligent activity through intellectual transitions.
An invalid rote inference and a successful adaptive response with no represented derivation test which requirements are intended.
Reasoning
Creation
Read reasoning as construction of consequences, distinctions, frames, or questions. Repetition without new content challenges universality.
Read creation as construction governed by intellectual transformations. Unguided generation and natural formation must be addressed.
Process in the primary senses; constructive reasoning is a narrower overlap.
The hierarchy makes generation central to reasoning and explicit operations central to creation.
Repeat a previously established inference with no new target-relative content; generate arbitrary novel forms without reasoning about them.
Discovery
Creation
Treat discovery as construction of a previously unavailable distinction. This does not cover every recovery of existing material.
Treat creation as discovery within a space of possibilities. Specify whether the possibility already existed and what is newly available to whom.
Change; or changes in an investigation's available possibilities under a stated frame.
The change concerns whether novelty belongs to the object, representation, or inquirer's access.
The same old question can be found by one person and newly formulated by another. Track both histories without declaring them identical.
Search
Creation
Use generative search, where exploring the space constructs candidates. Locating-only searches remain counterexamples to the universal claim.
Describe creation as search through possible arrangements. This requires a meaningful space and exploration relation, not a retrospective label.
Process; candidate exploration is a useful proposed parent for selected methods.
Search stops being limited to lookup; creation acquires explicit alternative spaces and selection paths.
Compare a database lookup with generation that changes the very dimensions of the candidate space.
Questions
Creation
Classify question-forming activity as creation, or question specifications as creations. Neither says the specification is a creating process.
Study creation as a response to unresolved distinctions, using Questions as a programme of inquiry rather than a strict subtype parent.
Subject; specifications or processes only after choosing a consistent classified item.
This makes question formation investigable while exposing the gap between a product, a process, and the question directing it.
Recover an old question, rephrase it, change its referent, then construct a different requested distinction.
Questions
Goals
Interpret a question as a goal to resolve a distinction. This adds an intended resolution that hypothetical or idle questions need not carry.
Represent a goal as a question about what would constitute or bring about achievement. The specification has been translated, not proved identical.
Representation in the primary model; specifications guiding possible work under a broader proposed class.
Inquiry and pursuit become mutually translatable, while formulation remains distinct from commitment.
A person can formulate a question they do not want answered or describe an unadopted goal.
Goals
Preferences
Treat goals as favored outcome conditions. A goal adopted under obligation may not be the agent's favored alternative.
Treat preferences as implicit goals that would be pursued if constraints allowed. This adds counterfactual pursuit conditions.
Conditions guiding selection, proposed; the primary senses are specifications versus relations.
The hierarchy changes whether wanting, valuing, and undertaking are treated as distinct contributors.
An agent favors one outcome, judges another better, and commits to a third because of a constraint.
Preferences
Values
Interpret preference as a person's operative valuation. This is descriptive worth, not necessarily justified worth.
Interpret values as stable or generalized preferences. This is a reduction hypothesis, not a consequence of both affecting choice.
Valuation relations under explicitly descriptive senses.
The relation between observed favoring and reasons for favoring becomes the central issue.
Construct a case where an agent rejects their own immediate preference on a standard they endorse.
Judgment
Decisions
Treat a verdict as a decision to accept a proposition or standard. This broadens commitment beyond operative action.
Treat deciding as judging what to undertake. This may hide choices made without an explicit evaluative verdict.
Operation and Process in the admitted model; some episodes also overlap as reflective selection.
Epistemic acceptance and practical commitment become comparable without being silently interchangeable.
Reach a verdict but defer acting; adopt an action under uncertainty about its comparative merit.
Planning
Strategy
Under the shared course/result sense, the same prospective arrangement satisfies both definitions.
Under the same sense, the reverse also holds. This yields equivalent extensions, not two meaningful levels.
Representation and Artifact in the primary model.
To obtain a genuine hierarchy, introduce a property such as contingency structure, policy generality, or competitive context and test it.
Use the same conditional course twice, changing only its label. No new type distinction has been established.
Planning
Action
Classify the process of making plans as action; an unexecuted plan is still not an occurrence of acting.
Treat action as enacted planning only if the action follows a represented prospective course. Unplanned action is a counterexample.
Process if both are activities; the current primary senses deliberately distinguish plan from performance.
The distinction exposes the difference between a specification, its construction, and its execution.
Keep a plan unchanged while execution stops; act spontaneously without first producing a plan.
Representation
Understanding
Treat a representation as an external component realizing usable grasp. A misleading or unused representation defeats the universal claim.
Treat understanding as an internally usable representation. This is a proposed account of capability, not just a new folder.
Conditions enabling use of relations, a proposed functional parent.
The focus shifts from possession of content to what a representation enables an agent to do.
Compare verbatim reproduction, correct transfer to a new case, and an accurate diagram that nobody can use.
Memory
Knowledge
Restrict memory to retained true, adequately supported content. False memories and unsupported records no longer qualify.
Treat knowledge as usable retained results. Explain immediate knowledge and the requirements that separate retention from knowing.
Availability for later work under an explicitly functional account.
A store must preserve warrant and context, while epistemic status still requires its own grounds.
Recover a false claim with perfect fidelity and a true claim without its support or rejected status.
Truth
Knowledge
Restrict truth to what is known or knowable under an account. This adds an epistemic limitation to a truth condition.
Treat knowledge as truth possessed with appropriate grounds. Possession and support are extra conditions, not synonyms for truth.
Epistemic requirements, proposed; primary truth and knowing-state meanings are not a simple parent/child pair.
The hierarchy reveals whether a proposed science is about what holds, what is warranted, or what an agent possesses.
An unrecognized truth and a confidently held falsehood separate holding, support, and acceptance.
Explanation
Prediction
Read an explanation through the conditional forecasts its account licenses. An account may explain an already known contrast without recorded predictive success.
Read a prediction as a compressed explanation. A forecast can lack a dependence account altogether.
Representation in the primary model; Model for the subset used to draw consequences.
The same account can be assessed along independent explanatory and predictive relations.
Compare a mechanistic account that misses a forecast with an accurate extrapolation that supplies no mechanism.
Writing
Reasoning
Treat writing as intellectual transformations performed through text. Pure copying or transcription challenges the universal version.
Treat reasoning as inscription in a medium, including internal or external representations. This requires broadening writing beyond text.
Process in the primary model; representational transformation as a proposed narrower parent.
Writing can become a means of constructing an argument instead of reporting a completed one.
A rewrite that reveals a missing premise and a rewrite changing only punctuation separate substantive transformation from expression.
Prompting
Communication
Under the primary sense, prompting is communication addressed to a model to influence its work.
Treat every communication as prompting an addressee's next state or action. This broadens prompting beyond model instructions and may absorb mere expression.
Process; contribution-mediated coordination under a broader proposed class.
The reverse encourages studying all contributions by the continuations they make available.
Compare an instruction, a greeting, private unaddressed writing, and a misunderstood request.
Prompting
Control
Control is a proposed new parent: prompting attempts to change the model's selected operation or interpretation through an input.
The reverse would define control as addressed instruction; physical constraints and automatic feedback then become counterexamples.
Means of governing subsequent work, proposed and not inserted into the admitted vocabulary merely by this row.
The scope changes from better wording to the interface between available capability and selected operation.
Hold the model and task fixed while varying the contribution that determines its next operation.
Attention
Allocation
Under the primary senses, operative focus allocation is one kind of allocation.
Broaden attention to governance of all resources. Then allocation can be considered attention, but this changes its target range.
Operation and Process in the primary model.
The reverse invites a general control theory rather than assuming cognition has a separate resource mechanism.
Compare allocating physical storage automatically with redirecting an inquirer's focus to a forgotten correction.
Resources
Subject
Under the potential-subject sense, any resource can be considered as a subject.
Treat any subject as a possible resource for some use. This requires a use to be specified or existentially justified; it does not make everything useful to the present task.
Contextual roles, proposed; Subject is the broad admitted parent.
The reversal changes an object of study into possible means of work.
An item can be studied while having no established contribution to the current purpose; do not invent one solely to fill the table.
System
Method
Classify a system by the repeatable procedure it implements. An organized physical arrangement is not thereby the prescription itself.
Treat a method as a system of coordinated operations. This is a useful method-design frame with operations as components.
Organized means for work, proposed; the primary senses distinguish arrangement from prescription.
Systems acquire explicit operations; methods acquire interactions, dependencies, and failure conditions.
The same method can have different implementations, and the same system can execute different methods.
Framework
System
Under the authored organization sense, a framework is a system of concepts and relations.
Treat every system as a framework for the behaviors it permits. This changes framework from conceptual artifact to enabling arrangement.
Configuration in the primary model; organization as a broader proposed parent.
The reverse treats architecture as structuring a space of possibilities rather than just performing one function.
A simple malfunctioning mechanism remains a system without supplying a conceptual framework for an investigator.
Tool
Instrument
Under the primary definitions, an authored tool is an instrument provided for a specified operation.
Restrict instruments to authored means. Unmodified natural objects deliberately used as means are then excluded by stipulation.
Resources; authored means form the narrower Tool branch.
The boundary determines whether constraints, questions, natural objects, and operations can count as tools.
A manufactured weight and an unmodified stone used as a weight discriminate authored artifact from assigned use.
Evaluation
Improvement
Classify successful evaluative correction as improvement; unchanged or irrelevant assessments defeat the universal claim.
Treat improvement as a result whose betterment must be evaluated. Requiring evaluation does not make the change an evaluation act.
Work on comparative adequacy, proposed; acts and comparative changes remain distinct.
The relation exposes assessment as both a possible operation and a possible consumer of a changed result.
An assessment can be correct while nothing improves; a change can improve before anyone measures it.
Integration
Improvement
Define integration as beneficial coordination. Harmful integration is then excluded by the new definition.
Treat improvement as resolving component incompatibilities. Many improvements by substitution or removal need no new integration.
Change; beneficial coordination is a restricted intersection.
The hierarchy changes whether increasing connectedness is a goal or only one possible means.
Connect two systems and make both less effective; remove a connection and improve the outcome.
Automation
Intelligence
Require automatic operation to adaptively select and revise its means. Fixed repetition no longer qualifies as automation in that narrowed sense.
Treat intelligence as autonomous operation of an appropriate repertoire. Automatic execution alone remains insufficient for adaptive adequacy.
Configurations enabling activity, proposed after changing intelligence from capability to realization.
It exposes two independent requirements: execution without repeated instruction and choosing fitting work.
A fixed timer repeats a mistake; a capable agent chooses correctly only after being explicitly prompted.
Self-improvement
Learning
Require self-betterment to be caused by experience-dependent update. Fixed self-repair then falls outside the narrowed sense.
Require learning to better the learner. Maladaptive and neutral updates are excluded by a normative stipulation.
Change; beneficial self-directed experiential update is their narrower intersection.
Self-reference, cause of change, and comparative merit become separately testable conditions.
A fixed self-repair succeeds without changing its policy; feedback changes a policy for the worse.
Education
Learning
Classify achieved learner change rather than the teaching activity. Unsuccessful education does not become evidence of no educational activity.
Treat all learning as education if the environment is considered a teacher. This broadens agency and organized intent substantially.
Development of capability, proposed with process/change distinctions retained.
The reversal moves attention from the provider's activity to what actually changes in the learner.
A lesson produces no lasting change; accidental experience changes later behavior without any teaching intention.
Collaboration
Communication
Treat coordination of shared work as communicative interaction. Coordination through artifacts or implicit division of work tests the scope of communication.
Treat communication as collaboration on a shared interpretive situation. Adversarial or one-sided contributions challenge the shared-work condition.
Coordinated activity, proposed; Process is admitted but does not establish shared purpose.
The relation reveals where shared aims, exchanged content, and actual coordination come apart.
Two people coordinate silently; one communicates a threat; a group talks but fails to coordinate its work.
Science
Philosophy
Classify empirical method as a specialization of investigating concepts and grounds. This requires a broader philosophy scope than a conventional field boundary.
Classify philosophy as systematic testing of conjectures. Explain how conceptual and normative tests satisfy the intended scientific criteria.
Field in the primary model; Investigative practice under activity readings.
The reversal changes method requirements and evidential obligations rather than merely prestige or naming.
Apply both proposed definitions to a controlled measurement, a conceptual counterexample, and a normative argument.
Research
Problem solving
Interpret every investigation as addressing an obstruction to finding out. This treats epistemic gaps as problems and may exclude inquiry without a formulated obstacle.
Interpret every attempted remedy as an investigation of what works. Routine execution then needs to count as inquiry or remain a counterexample.
Process; purpose-governed inquiry is a restricted overlap.
One direction prioritizes unresolved knowledge; the other prioritizes difficulties and consequential remedies.
Compare open exploration, a routine successful repair, and an experiment that changes the question instead of solving the original problem.
Feedback
Memory
Require returned results to preserve earlier content into later work. The result-return relation then uses retention but is not necessarily identical to it.
Interpret all retention as delayed feedback. This requires a later receiving use or an account of feedback potential.
Relation in the primary model; conditions for later work to depend on earlier results.
The reversal places delayed availability and immediate return in one temporal framework while retaining whether an update actually occurred.
A result is archived forever unused; a controller receives a signal but changes no rule.
Constraint
Creation
Treat constraints as creators of a restricted possibility space. This names a consequence of imposing a constraint, not the condition itself as a process.
Treat creation as establishing constraints that individuate an artifact. Specify which boundaries are necessary for identity.
Conditions shaping alternatives, proposed after specifying the classified items.
Restrictions become potential productive operations instead of only limitations.
Hold the intended result fixed, impose a new restriction, and identify the new candidate or distinction that becomes possible.
Connections
Transformation
Read a connection as a rule relating an input state to an output state. Static relations do not automatically prescribe change.
Read a transformation through the relation between its before and after states. That represents the change without making every static relation a changing event.
Relational structure after fixing whether the subject is a change, its rule, or its representation.
The hierarchy exposes whether the project studies what relates, what can happen, or what actually changes.
Compare a static ordering relation, a permutation rule, and an executed rearrangement.
Understanding
Improvement
Study developing understanding as betterment of usable grasp. Possession of understanding and harmful acquisition of a misleading account remain separate cases.
Interpret improvement as increased understanding of how to attain the result. Mechanical or accidental improvements challenge this reduction.
Change in usable capability for the narrower developmental overlap.
The reversal separates a theory of an activity from being able to perform it and from making its outcome better.
Improve a mechanical part without any new understanding; gain an insight that does not improve the chosen outcome.
Type
Subject
A class and its membership conditions can be considered, so Type is admitted under potential Subject.
Treat every subject as a type only after selecting a unit and giving membership conditions. A particular event as subject is not already a class.
Subject in the potential-role sense.
The distinction prevents every studied item from silently becoming a universal category.
Study one particular decision; separately define the class of decisions satisfying a condition. Instance and class have changed.
Model
Framework
Treat a model as a framework organizing target relations. An isolated representation may not have the organizing role required.
Treat a framework as a model of possible work or a domain. Specify what it represents and what consequences it licenses.
Artifact in the primary model; organized representation in a restricted overlap.
The reverse makes a framework's assertions and omissions testable rather than treating organization as neutral.
Compare a numerical forecast model, a taxonomy, and a method-selection framework against their declared targets.
projects: The described design-method specification, not an execution or the resulting artifact.
Developing diverse candidates, selected aspects, requirements, iterations, and feasibility.
A method for discovering standards through contrast, with artifact creation as one application.
SDS can serve improvement, but a described method is not an actual improvement; an unsuccessful iteration remains a method use.
Six local specifications exist; comparative effectiveness and every target-specific version are unestablished.
The described organization of question identities, typed routes, sequences, and chains.
Preserving distinct question structures and answer-dependent continuations.
A way of specifying conditional future work, with questions as the branching medium.
Not every plan is a QuestionRoute structure, and using questions does not make a route the same type of thing as one question.
Typed routes, sequences, chains, and regress cannot be substituted without inspecting their meanings.
The described discovery hierarchy and status/contribution organization.
Scope-relative discovery status, contribution links, references, and continuations.
A system for governing changes in what an inquiry can use and pursue.
A discovery organizer can preserve an unresolved or erroneous candidate; its existence is not a discovered truth.
Current hierarchy and older prerequisite-graph descriptions have different versioned meanings.
The described organization of goals, procedures, gates, project states, and continuation.
Connecting aims, prerequisites, decisions, execution states, and outcome conditions.
A system for preserving the relationship between intended conditions and actual continuing work.
A passed gate or produced plan need not achieve a goal. The project specification is not itself an achievement event.
Native versions and individual procedures require exact source fidelity when executed.
The described authored collection of procedures and invocation relationships.
Making individually specified intellectual procedures available for use.
A repertoire of operations for changing the form and continuation of intellectual work.
A library containing reasoning methods is not one reasoning episode or a demonstrated intelligent agent.
Specific procedures need their own kind assignment; the collection is not one unchanged universal method.
The inspected operating contract and authored operation-research material.
Choosing and constructing contributions; distinguishing availability, selection, representation, and use failures.
A contribution-selection framework: making existing capability become the fitting operation now.
An intellectual operating contract does not demonstrate the capability or behavioral change it is designed to support.
The inspected CURRENT contract has authority over newer generated dispatcher proposals.
Unresolved named source; only a proposed role is available.
Proposed account of how subjects and methods relate; defining artifact not resolved.
A candidate grammar of allowable relationships among subjects, systems, operations, and results.
Neither the word Master nor Framework establishes an implemented framework, sufficient method, or universal parent.
All source-dependent kind assignments remain open until the defining artifact is found.
Constructive right-assumption consequences and wrong-assumption cases, alternatives, implications, and further questions.
A method for changing the operative role of a claim: starting assumption, target of defeat, or generator of consequences.
It is not merely negation or evaluation. A complaint compatible with a claim is not a counterexample.
This workbook studies the described method; it does not claim an exact execution of the original procedure.
The described argument-challenge procedure and retained error artifacts.
Exact argument targets, targeted error vectors, counterexamples, and failure reports.
An instrument for finding where a conclusion's dependence on premises fails.
Defeating an inference does not necessarily falsify its conclusion; the method is not truth itself.
An untested error vector is not a passed or failed argument check.
The described organization of preference observations, hypotheses, predictions, and feedback.
Separating observed reactions, inferred preferences, predicted ratings, and exceptions.
A system for discovering context-sensitive selection patterns rather than collecting approvals.
Predicted agreement is not actual preference evidence, and agreement is not truth or benefit.
Programmed confidence increments have not established calibration.
The historical formal-claim organization preserved in ProjectVersions.
Formula structure, assumptions, canonical identity rules, justification, and derivation traces.
A structure for preserving the identity and dependence of a claim through derivation and revision.
A formal claim structure is not automatically a true claim or an effectively usable capability.
Do not merge this historical identity with the later AxiomNet/Strategizer transition.
The described collection of native formal tools and claim structures.
Distinct logical tools and structures, with differing maturity.
A set of concrete transformations on formal material whose execution can be examined separately from its vocabulary.
An implementation named for logic is not evidence of complete logical validity or working persistence.
Some native code or structures remain unfinished or inconsistent.
The described organization of strategy families, conditions, variants, and counterstrategies.
Making a course conditional on context, entry conditions, and possible counterplay.
A system for conditional adequacy: preserving where a proposed course works and where it fails.
A generated strategy is not a tested successful course, and competitive context does not alone prove an exclusive type against planning.
Version identity matters during the current AxiomNet naming transition.
The described authored conversational operating system and consultation organization.
Choosing fitting contributions across mixed conversational situations and consulting actual methods.
A director of available contributions rather than a single fixed response-producing procedure.
An interaction design does not by its name establish intelligence or justify a mandatory production sequence for every exchange.
Source consultation practices and native distinctions remain part of the described contribution.
The authored collection of distinct representation families and corpora.
Concept hubs, depth/dependency forms, conversational moves, and continuous regress material.
A repertoire of ways to make different continuations visible from the same intellectual material.
Many representations do not establish many insights, and a new description is not necessarily a new discovery.
The source families remain distinct; corpus size is not evidence of novelty or quality.
The authored investigations, proposed procedures, and answer–attack–revision artifacts.
Worked conceptual investigations and revisable question/answer structures.
A collection of ways to continue and revise conceptual investigations.
A repository about philosophy is not the whole field, and produced text does not establish automation of all philosophical inquiry.
Distinguish particular investigations, method proposals, and their observed results.
The described distributed plans and book artifacts.
Project plans and a book family distributed across the source projects.
A programme for constructing investigative products, whose continuation would have to be tied to evidence and revision.
Plans for automated science are not an automated scientist, a discovery, or evidence of runtime experimental capability.
Some books reside in QuestionRoute; the project name exceeds what the inspected artifacts demonstrate.
The authored ontology, configurations, operations, maps, and verdict history.
Distinguishing resources, uses, arrangements, operations, comparisons, and correction history.
A way of reconstructing subjects through what arrangements make alternatives available and what their consequences are.
A resource-allocation interpretation is a frame to test, not evidence that every subject has been reduced without loss.
Rejected and reconstructed verdicts must retain their historical standing.
The authored capability distinctions, component accounts, and proposed explanatory structures.
Separating capacity, realized behavior, causes, constraints, targets, and interventions.
An investigation of what prevents available ability from becoming self-initiated, persistent, interruptible behavior.
A proposed mechanism or control arrangement is not an established causal explanation or demonstrated intervention.
Candidate mechanisms and actual evidence retain different standing.
The authored recovered-source organization, native structures, relationships, and checks.
Preserving earlier source identity and context so they can become usable in later work.
An instrument for preserving the conditions under which earlier results remain valid and useful.
Byte recovery is not semantic completeness, and preserved advice does not establish that later behavior uses it.
Semantic invalidation and some portable-case dependencies remain unfinished.
The documented software scaffold and interface design, not verified runtime behavior.
Described skill/script runs, side-by-side comparisons, and retained run history.
An interface that makes operations, comparisons, and continuation inspectable.
A runner is not the intellectual method it runs, and a comparison interface does not establish the comparison standard.
